positive_evidence: Actual316L original experimental chapter4.1 plus heat-treatment chapter5.1, not just a literature review.
Exact aggregate fracture-stress distribution values, method metadata and source group counts are openly available underCCBY4.
Source batch1/2/3 labels are physical manufacturing-batch groups for S10, but no lab specimen-to-batch crosswalk is published.
Distinct initial failure/runout status remains displayed for later fractography; higher-stress reloads do not justify calling every graph failure invalid.
admission_boundary: No individual numeric Nf table found in the thesis. Figures4.6/5.4/8.3/8.4 contain overlapping plotted observations and fitted/summary marks.
Runouts at1e7 are reloaded at higher stress for fracture-origin analysis. No specimen/history keys permit certified per-point first-exposure separation yet.
Table8.1 values are fitted FRACTURE-STRESS quantiles, not observed life values or R90C90 confidence bounds. No pseudo-observations are manufactured.
No explicit fatigue temperature/environment or numericalKt is supplied in the inspected original methods. Blank fields cannot be replaced by25C/air/Kt1.
Chapter4.1 and DOI10.1016/j.msea.2023.145651 overlap explicitly; chapter5 uses a separate batch mix but remains in the same author-program source block.
Table3.5 repeats reference variants across investigation packages; Table8.1 includes pooled S10 plus nested batch subgroups. These counts are not additive.
This Jun Zhang Bremen program is not linked to the v4 Zhang2017/2019 family merely by surname.
